rationale: The answer is an honest negative abstention after the CAPEC specialist failed, but it does not state any of the expected alternate terms for the pattern that CAPEC-384 is a more specific case of. It only offers unsupported example identifiers T1566, M1017, and CAPEC-98, and the query is visible in the trace rather than in the abstention itself. Therefore it is partial: none of the five gold terms (Man-in-the-Middle / MITM, Monkey-in-the-Middle, Monster-in-the-Middle, On-path Attacker, Person-in-the-Middle / PiTM) are present, but no false mapping is asserted.
